transactions.note: Implied orders = real GMV / real IPI price. GMV and spend per buyer are Fiverr Inc. reported; the price is this project's real GEKS composite, annual mean. * trailing twelve months to 2026Q2.

category_transactions.note: Within-gig review accrual, the only category-level quantity in the project -- Fiverr Inc. publishes no category split. Age-adjusted (gig, quarter and age fixed effects), 2020 four-quarter mean = 100. The SHAPE is identified; the TREND is not, because within a gig age and calendar quarter move one-for-one. Mean quarters spanned per observation widens 1.2 to 1.75 across the window, so part of the 2024 fall is the archive capturing gigs less often.
